findings.fix: example.target: Ich gehe heute Abend auf eine Party, kommst du mit? | example.en: I'm going to a party tonight, are you coming along?

findings.problem: The phrase uses mitkommen, not among the 1,000 most common words.

back.target: Are you coming along? / Are you coming with me (us)?
back.example: I'm going to a party this evening. Are you coming along?

note: The informal hint is needed here, because it rules out the Sie form "Kommen Sie mit?".
